material.description: After applying the 6.88w3 doodad layer, 41 of the target map's 100 type codes cannot be identified and ship nothing: no 6.88g row, and no name in either map's doodad table. YTpb (109 placements) and APms (78) are the two largest, together 187 of the roughly 200 placements still missing; DOtb is also unresolved. The reachable source so far is a partial WorldEditStrings.txt (about 513 entries against well over a thousand). Witness: the reason column of scenarios/moba/doodad-types-w3.tsv and the placed count from place-doodads-688g.mjs.
material.subject: 41 doodad codes of the target map are unidentified, so their placements are dropped
material.witness: Row resolved. Owner direction kept: the 39 codes 6.88g cannot name ship their kinds as at 0c71b08b (kindless count 39, zero kind diffs vs origin doodad-types-w3.tsv) and all 39 carry the UNVERIFIED reason. Regeneration diff DIFF_LINES=0 over 100 codes. Witness session verify-content-doodad-codes-unresolved. Marking landed on 638eac606a0e080dc225fe33c14bed30e8c37343 (ci green, run 40166056548).
